legalReview.externalAgreementStatus: The official form links to a HiDrive-hosted Radio Airplay & Promotion Agreement. The public fetch surface required JavaScript and did not expose the document contents, so a human must inspect the document before acceptance.
legalReview.publishedLicenseSummary: The first-party terms state a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual license to stream and broadcast submitted content, display it on the app and website, use names, likenesses and biographies, and distribute snippets or full versions through social media and marketing campaigns.
legalReview.publishedCompensationSummary: The terms state that submissions do not create an entitlement to royalties, fees or other compensation unless a separate written agreement applies.

activityVerification.evidence: The first-party site has a current Rolling Admissions 2026 submission form, featured audio uploaded in May 2026, first-party blog posts dated June 5 and June 8, 2026, and current 2026 artist and event surfaces.

genreFitEvidence: The official form explicitly accepts electronic, reggae or dancehall, world or Afrobeats, pop, experimental, classical or instrumental and other genres relevant to MarcsMusic.
The network states that it serves independent and established artists worldwide and offers radio and TV consideration.
A specific broadcast-ready MarcsMusic track must still be selected by a human after legal and promotional-scope review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The active first-party route is legitimate and globally oriented, but it requires direct media uploads, personal data, rights declarations, acceptance of an externally hosted agreement and broad perpetual promotional terms. AI eligibility, hidden live controls, the precise cost boundary and all selected services require human review.

notes: One Variety Vibes Radio & TV opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form field was filled, no file was uploaded, no agreement was accepted, no login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
